segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: חָבֵר שֶׁמֵּת — אִשְׁתּוֹ וּבָנָיו וּבְנֵי בֵּיתוֹ הֲרֵי הֵן בְּחֶזְקָתָן, עַד שֶׁיֵּחָשֵׁדוּ. וְכֵן חָצֵר שֶׁמּוֹכְרִין בָּהּ תְּכֵלֶת — הֲרֵי הִיא בְּחֶזְקָתָהּ, עַד שֶׁתִּיפָּסֵל.
segments.en: «The Sages taught» in a baraita: In the case of «a ḥaver that died, his wife and children and members of his household retain their presumptive» status «until they are suspected» of engaging in inappropriate deeds. «And similarly,» in the case of «a courtyard in which one sells sky-blue dye, it retains its presumptive» status as a place in which fit sky-blue dye is sold «until it is disqualified» due to the merchant’s unscrupulous behavior.
